speaker: Astronaut
text: I need your help. My ship crashed and my freaking battery is completely dead.

speaker: Martian
text: I might have a spare energy core... but nothing on Mars is free, human.

speaker: Astronaut
text: What do you want in return?

speaker: Martian
text: There's an annoying monument nearby that offends my artistic sensibilities. Help me destroy it, and the battery is yours.

speaker: Astronaut
text: Deal! I know what to do.
